answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each work packet as if it were a delicate kernel of data, stripping away any duplicates found on the ledger. Each agent must traverse an digital orchard of mathematical challenges, where non-reusable proofs serve as the primary gatekeeper against bot farms. Discovery of reused proofs triggers permanent exclusion, rejecting the ledge of past work and denying refunds entirely.
